title_en: Before you transfer: don't guess any of these
title_zh: 转账之前，这几项一个也别猜
goal_en: Check the coin, network, address, memo and arrival conditions, and send a small test first.
goal_zh: 会核对币种、网络、地址、备注及到账条件，并先做小额测试。

shots.visual_en: Sam sees only the lower fee and goes to switch networks. Nexubo's antenna snaps red with a short 'ding'; a red chip pops up: 'Network must match'.
shots.visual_zh: 小白只看到费用便宜就准备换网络；小纳天线变红并“叮”一声，弹出红色警示条“网络必须匹配”。

lines.en: This network is cheaper. Why not just switch?
lines.zh: 这个网络更便宜，随便换它不就好了？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E09' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第09集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Before you transfer: don't guess any of these
onscreen_text_zh: 转账之前，这几项一个也别猜

shots.visual_en: A sender card and a receiver card; coin and network lines connect and must match on both ends.
shots.visual_zh: 发送方和接收方各一张卡，币种、网络同时连线匹配。

lines.en: First confirm which asset and network the receiver supports. Then think about fees. If the two ends don't match, don't send just because it's cheaper. Even USDT can live on different networks.
lines.zh: 先确认收款方支持哪种资产和网络，再选择费用。两端不匹配，不能因为便宜就发送。同叫泰达币，也可能在不同网络上。

shots.visual_en: Mail analogy: network = route, address = destination. A big label says 'Analogy only'.
shots.visual_zh: 邮寄类比：网络像路线，地址像目的地；大字注明仅帮助理解。

lines.en: For now, think of the network as the route and the address as the destination. But two addresses can look alike and still not work on the same network. Always check that the receiving platform supports this chain and this asset.
lines.zh: 你可以暂时把网络想成路线，把地址想成目的地，但地址看起来一样，也不代表网络兼容。必须查看接收平台对这条链和这项资产的支持。

shots.visual_en: Full checklist lights up item by item: coin, network, full address, Memo/Tag if required, minimum deposit, estimated arrival.
shots.visual_zh: 完整核对表：币种、网络、完整地址、如需的Memo/Tag、最低充值、预计到账；依次点亮。

lines.en: Copy the address from the receiving page, then check all of it. If a memo or tag is required, fill it in. Confirm the minimum deposit, the withdrawal fee and the amount that will arrive. Don't judge an address by its first and last few characters.
lines.zh: 从收款页面复制地址，再核对完整内容。若要求备注或标签，也要填写。确认最低充值、提币费用和到账金额；不要只靠地址前后几个字符判断。

shots.visual_en: A small test that meets the minimum arrives and is credited; then the details are re-checked before the next transfer. Self-custody path shows a note about the network fee asset.
shots.visual_zh: 满足最低额度的一笔小额测试到达并入账，再重核后续转账信息；自托管路径提示网络手续费资产。

lines.en: Send a small test that meets the minimum, and confirm it was actually credited. For a bigger transfer, check everything again. Don't blindly reuse old records. For self-custody transfers, have the network fee ready too.
lines.zh: 先做一笔满足最低条件的小额测试，并确认接收方实际入账。后续大额仍要重新核对，不能盲目复用历史记录。自托管转账还要准备相应网络手续费。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Same address, but the receiving platform doesn't support this network. Can you send?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：地址一样，收款平台不支持该网络，能不能转？

lines.en: One more check before sending beats looking for help after a mistake.
lines.zh: 转账前多核对一次，比转错后找人补救更重要。

onscreen_text_zh: 网络不支持 → 不能转

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: It says 'success', but nothing arrived. Don't send it again. Next: where to look.
lines.zh: 显示成功却没到账？先别再转。下一集：该查哪里。

onscreen_text_en: It says 'success', but nothing arrived. Don't send it again. Next: where to look.
onscreen_text_zh: 显示成功却没到账？先别再转。下一集：该查哪里。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。
onscreen_text_en: One verified gateway to the world's exchanges
onscreen_text_zh: 全球交易所，一个官方入口

end_hook.en: It says 'success', but nothing arrived. Don't send it again. Next: where to look.
end_hook.zh: 显示成功却没到账？先别再转。下一集：该查哪里。

page_cta.line_en: Get the printable pre-transfer checklist in our Telegram channel.
page_cta.line_zh: 到我们的 Telegram 频道领取可打印的“转账前检查清单”。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: In a practice withdrawal form with deliberate errors, fix the network mismatch and the missing memo; then send a virtual small test.
exercise.task_zh: 在故意有错的模拟提币表里纠正网络不匹配和缺失备注；再做虚拟小额测试。
exercise.answer_en: Submit only when every key condition matches. There is no default 'auto-switch to the right network' protection.
exercise.answer_zh: 所有关键条件匹配才可提交；没有“自动改成正确网络”的默认保护。

red_lines: Never show a real receivable QR code or a full valid address ｜ 不展示真实可收款二维码或完整有效地址
'Gas' is not a coin you must hold for every exchange withdrawal ｜ “Gas”不是每次交易所提币必须自行持有的币
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
